{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicate patient_id entries by keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# This ensures each patient is represented once, with the latest sample
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Check the result
print(trial_df.shape)
print(trial_df['severity'].value_counts())"}
